title: Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem”?
options: It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Kotlin targets have different runtimes and APIs; choose JVM, JS, Native, Wasm, or Multiplatform according to application requirements.
It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
questions.answer_key: Kotlin targets have different runtimes and APIs; choose JVM, JS, Native, Wasm, or Multiplatform according to application requirements.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Kotlin targets have different runtimes and APIs; choose JVM, JS, Native, Wasm, or Multiplatform according to application requirements. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

questions.prompt: Which learning/debugging practice is most reliable for “Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem”?
options: Assume the compiler or toolchain is broken without reducing the example.
Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
Change several unrelated parts at once and keep the result that looks plausible.
Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.
questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
questions.explanation: A minimal reproducible example and version-aware testing separate a real behavior from a mistaken assumption. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

questions.prompt: Which claim should a learner avoid when applying “Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem”?
options: Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version.
Never inspect the official API reference for the selected target.
Treat draft or experimental features as universally stable.
Expose every internal implementation detail to every caller.
questions.answer_key: Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version.
questions.explanation: The misconception to avoid is: Understanding the Kotlin Ecosystem removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.
